content.value:
Our Annual Report for 2021/22 is now available. The report includes highlights from the past year, as well as our financial and management information. Read it for the latest updates about how we’ve delivered the schools’ payroll over the past year, and our online payroll service EdPay, which we’ve built for schools. We detail the roll-out of EdPay, the delivery model we have used, our customer focus, our agile methodology and what our customers say about EdPay – the future of schools’ payroll.
Click here to read the report.
